d:
The 76ers defeated the Bulls, 126-107 tonight in Philadelphia. Tyrese Maxey contributed a team-high 26 points to go with 11 assists 4 rebounds and 2 steals, with Jaylen Brown of the 76ers adding an additional 25 points (9-15 FG, 4-7 3P) in the game. Caleb Wilson finished with a team-high 24 points along with 7 rebounds for the Bulls in the losing effort. The 76ers improve their record to 7-1 with the win, while the Bulls fall to 1-6 for the season.
